authorization: User approved the unseen-source normal-gait test proposed after reviewing ljmu100-mixed. The input-perturbation test was proposed in the same plan as step 2.
question: Does the LJMU-mixed GDI model give high scores because a walk is normal, or because the input looks like LJMU?
models: Existing baseline (Stanford only) and mixed (Stanford + LJMU881 assumed100) checkpoints from studies/20261104-ljmu100-mixed. Fixed fusion rule and weights from bundle/ensemble.json. No retraining, recalibration or weight search.

test_sets.live: LIVE-GaitNeuroKids typically developing children, 9 people, 12 records, 5-10y, from matched-normal100/child/data.npz. Not used by either arm. All 5 outer-fold models are averaged.
test_sets.self: Self-recorded Test01, 3 adults, 13 videos: 6 normal, 7 imitated abnormal. Labels were corrected by the user after an earlier scoring and are used for reporting only. Not used by either arm. All 5 outer-fold models are averaged.
test_sets.ljmu: LJMU 64 people, 881 records, all 3305 windows. Each record is scored only by the outer fold that held that person out.

excluded_sets.kuopio: Public OpenPose sequences last about 1 s at 100 Hz, so the 124-frame input cannot be formed without changing time.
excluded_sets.movi: No BODY25 pose was extracted and the strict side-view 124-frame count was 0.

perturbations_on_ljmu.original: No change. Also serves as replay of saved predictions.
perturbations_on_ljmu.frame_shuffle: Feature level. One random time permutation per window, same for both sides, seed 20261105. Keeps each frame pose, destroys temporal order.
perturbations_on_ljmu.static_mean: Feature level. Every frame replaced by that window time mean. Removes all motion.
perturbations_on_ljmu.left_leg_stiff: Raw BODY25 before unchanged preprocessing. Left knee, ankle and foot points follow the left hip at their mean offset. Removes left-leg motion.
perturbations_on_ljmu.both_amp50: Raw BODY25 before unchanged preprocessing. Both knees, ankles and feet keep 50 percent of motion around their mean offset from the hip. Mimics small steps.

aggregation: Window to record before calibration; left-right mean; record to person (live, ljmu) or video (self); equal weight per person or video.

live_and_self_normal.generalizes: Mixed fusion group mean >= 90 in that set.
live_and_self_normal.source_recognition_leaning: Mixed fusion group mean < 90 in that set.
live_and_self_normal.overall: Both >= 90: supports learning normal gait. Both < 90: supports source recognition. One each: inconclusive.

preregistered_criteria.self_discrimination: Report mixed normal minus abnormal gap and whether video score ranges overlap, against baseline gap 12.67 and non-overlap.

perturbations.appearance_dependent: Mixed person mean stays >= 95 under frame_shuffle or static_mean.
perturbations.motion_responsive: Mixed person mean falls by >= 10 from original under that condition.

validation.checkpoint_hashes: Every checkpoint SHA-256 must match the stored member record.
validation.replay_self: Baseline fusion on self features must reproduce saved Test01 predictions.
validation.replay_ljmu: Baseline and mixed fusion on ljmu original must reproduce comparison-predictions.npz. Tolerance is above the earlier 0.001 because a CPU/GPU difference of 0.0012 is already recorded.

limitations: Live has 9 children and self has 3 adults, so group means are descriptive.
LIVE and self differ from LJMU in camera and possibly pose pipeline; a low score could reflect camera difference as well as source recognition. Both are parts of the same source question.
Perturbed inputs are not real pathology and can behave as out-of-distribution inputs; a score fall alone does not prove gait-quality sensing.
No measured GDI exists for any test set, so no accuracy is claimed.
